request.name: ajax Spider Action Remove Allowed Resource

query.description: (Required) The regular expression of the allowed resource.

query.description: (Required) The name of the context.

item.name: ajax Spider Action Scan

request.name: ajax Spider Action Scan

description.content: Runs the AJAX Spider against a given target.

query.description: The starting URL (needs to include the 'scheme').
A boolean (true/false) indicating whether or not the scan should be restricted to 'inScope' only resources (default value is false).
The name for any defined context. If the value does not match a defined context then an error will occur.
A boolean (true/false) indicating whether or not the crawl should be constrained to a specific path (default value is false).

item.name: ajax Spider Action Scan As User

request.name: ajax Spider Action Scan As User

description.content: Runs the AJAX Spider from the perspective of a User of the web application.

query.description: (Required) The name for any defined context. If the value does not match a defined context then an error will occur.
(Required) The name of the user to be used when crawling. The "userName" should be previously defined on the context configuration.
The starting URL (needs to include the 'scheme').
A boolean (true/false) indicating whether or not the crawl should be constrained to a specific path (default value is false).

item.name: ajax Spider Action Set Enabled Allowed Resource

request.name: ajax Spider Action Set Enabled Allowed Resource

description.content: Sets whether or not an allowed resource is enabled.

query.description: (Required) The regular expression of the allowed resource.
(Required) If the allowed resource should be enabled or not.

item.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Browser Id

request.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Browser Id

description.content: Sets the configuration of the AJAX Spider to use one of the supported browsers.

query.description: (Required) The name of the browser to be used by the AJAX Spider. (See the Selenium add-on help for a list of supported browsers.)

item.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Click Default Elems

request.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Click Default Elems

description.content: Sets whether or not the AJAX Spider will only click on the default HTML elements.

query.description: (Required) A boolean (true/false) indicating if only default elements such as 'a' 'button' 'input' should be clicked (default is true).

item.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Click Elems Once

request.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Click Elems Once

description.content: When enabled, the crawler attempts to interact with each element (e.g., by clicking) only once.

query.description: (Required) A boolean (true/false) indicating whether or not the AJAX Spider should only click on elements once. If this is set to false, the crawler will attempt to click multiple times; which is more rigorous but may take considerably more time (default is true).

item.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Enable Extensions

request.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Enable Extensions

query.description: (Required)

item.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Event Wait

request.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Event Wait

description.content: Sets the time to wait after an event (in milliseconds). For example: the wait delay after the cursor hovers over an element, in order for a menu to display, etc.

query.description: (Required) The time that the AJAX Spider should wait for each event (default is 1000 milliseconds).

item.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Logout Avoidance

request.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Logout Avoidance

description.content: Sets whether or not the AJAX Spider should avoid clicking logout elements.

query.description: (Required) A boolean (true/false) indicating if logout elements should be avoided (default is false).

item.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Max Crawl Depth

request.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Max Crawl Depth

description.content: Sets the maximum depth that the crawler can reach.

query.description: (Required) The maximum depth that the crawler should explore (zero means unlimited depth, default is 10).

item.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Max Crawl States

request.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Max Crawl States

description.content: Sets the maximum number of states that the crawler should crawl.

query.description: (Required) The maximum number of states that the AJAX Spider should explore (zero means unlimited crawl states, default is 0)

item.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Max Duration

request.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Max Duration

description.content: The maximum time that the crawler is allowed to run.

query.description: (Required) The maximum amount of time that the AJAX Spider is allowed to run (zero means unlimited running time, default is 60 minutes).

item.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Number Of Browsers

request.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Number Of Browsers

description.content: Sets the number of windows to be used by AJAX Spider.

query.description: (Required) The number of windows that the AJAX Spider can use. The more windows, the faster the process will be. However, more windows also means greater resource usage (CPU, Memory, etc), and could lead to concurrency issues depending on the app being explored (default is 1).

item.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Random Inputs

request.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Random Inputs

description.content: When enabled, inserts random values into form fields.

query.description: (Required) A boolean (true/false) indicating whether or not random values should be use in form fields. Otherwise, empty values are submitted (default is true).

item.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Reload Wait

request.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Reload Wait

description.content: Sets the time to wait after the page is loaded before interacting with it.

query.description: (Required) The number of milliseconds the AJAX Spider should wait after a page is loaded (default is 1000).

item.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Scope Check

request.name: ajax Spider Action Set Option Scope Check

description.content: Sets the scope check.

query.description: (Required) The scope check, either Strict or Flexible. Any other value will result in setting the default (Strict).

item.name: ajax Spider Action Stop

request.name: ajax Spider Action Stop

description.content: Stops the AJAX Spider.
